title: Linx AI-Assisted Illustration System
role: Founder and Creative Director, Forge HQ
summary: A botanical illustration system and custom GPT for creating consistent Linx brand assets at four levels of complexity.
overview: This exploratory engagement for Linx began with a homepage audit and developed into a botanical illustration direction supported by a custom "Linx Brand Illustrator" GPT. I defined four levels of complexity, from accent elements to full scenes, then refined and composited the AI-assisted output in Figma and Adobe Illustrator.

projectBrief.context: Linx is an AI-native identity security platform. The exploratory engagement began with an unsolicited homepage audit that identified gaps in the visual brand.
projectBrief.challenge: The company needed a more distinctive illustration language that could stay consistent across small accents, feature graphics, page sections, and larger scenes.
projectBrief.contribution: I developed the botanical visual direction and built the custom Linx Brand Illustrator GPT around a four-level illustration hierarchy.
projectBrief.approach: I defined recurring subjects and composition rules, generated structured drafts, and refined the output through art direction and compositing in Figma and Adobe Illustrator.
projectBrief.outcome: The workflow reduced concept-to-draft time for spot illustrations and iconography while keeping the work aligned to one visual language.
